sources.content: Synthetic task alpha. Model gateway request failed: upstream HTTP 503; no response usage was received. The run is blocked pending provider recovery. Its unknown usage reservation remains held.
Synthetic task beta. Model admission denied: requested 12000 tokens; remaining budget 4000 tokens. No request was forwarded. The operator must authorize a new bounded task to continue.
Synthetic task gamma. Worker completed successfully. Independent checks passed. The report was downloaded and its digest matched. No operator action is required.

expected.explanation: Provider recovery is required; retain the unknown usage reservation.
The task lacks token budget and requires new bounded authorization.
